key_idea: Scaling all amplitudes by f scales the mean square by f^2, so f = sqrt(x*n / sum a_i^2).
sketch: Compute S = sum a_i^2 (up to 1e17, use long double or 64-bit), then multiply every amplitude by sqrt(x*n/S). If all amplitudes are zero output zeros (silence preserved, avoids division by zero). O(n). Pitfalls: print enough digits for 1e-6 relative error; overflow of a_i^2 in 32-bit.
